items.title: "Aney Synodeias": The poetry of Nikiforos Blemenos becomes a song through the music of Giorgos Fanourakis
items.excerpt:
Yiorgos Fanourakis' music moves between the lyrical and the contemporary, incorporating experimentations that converse with modal and traditional music.

At the heart of the album's aesthetics is the thistle, the plant that adorns and the poetic collection. For the album cover, it is depicted through a design inspired by Minoan Crete, referring to the common origin of the two creators from Heraklion.

items.title: I was interviewed Parallaximag and Myrto!
items.excerpt: 'It's easy to be an artist. The hard part is trying to fit the expectations of others into your art and into your life in general. The hard part is waiting to get rich from your art. The difficult thing is to lose your compass and your inner base, to ignore inspiration, to become part of the system. But the artist difficult thing? Really? Lucky are those who are, unlucky are those who have not yet discovered the artist they definitely have inside them.”
